visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black and white Rakuten Monkeys jersey is shouting into a handheld microphone. He has short dark hair and is gesturing with his left hand while holding up three fingers. Behind him is a large yellow wall with the Chinese characters "精銳建設" and a dense crowd of spectators at a baseball stadium at night. (2) The camera pans to a wide shot of the stadium stands, filled with fans mostly wearing yellow or dark jerseys. Many fans are standing, waving their arms or clapping. The stadium lights are bright, creating a high-contrast nighttime environment. The atmosphere is extremely energetic as the entire crowd moves in rhythm. (3) A close-up shot features a female cheerleader with long dark hair and bangs, smiling broadly at the camera. She is wearing a black lace-textured top and a pink ribbon. Another cheerleader with reddish-brown hair is visible behind her, also cheering enthusiastically. They are surrounded by fans in the stands, some wearing white caps. (4) The visual climax shows thousands of long pink celebratory streamers being thrown from the stands toward the field. The screen is filled with falling pink ribbons as fans jump, scream, and film the moment with their smartphones. The bright stadium floodlights illuminate the pink streamers against the dark night sky. (5) The video ends with a black screen background featuring stylized white Traditional Chinese text that remains static until the video fades out.

He speaks in Traditional Chinese with an energetic, slightly strained delivery. The background is filled with a dense, loud crowd murmur and cheering, creating a high-energy acoustic environment. (2) A high-tempo drum beat and upbeat electronic-pop BGM begin to swell. The crowd noise transitions into a rhythmic chant and clapping. The main speaker's voice remains dominant, exhibiting high pitch variability and intensity as he hypes up the audience. The sound design captures the immense scale of the stadium. (3) Rhythmic clapping sounds become more distinct as the crowd synchronizes with the BGM. High-pitched female screaming and joyful yelling are audible in the background. The music has a triumphant major-key tonality, with bright synthesizer textures and a driving bass rhythm. (4) The audio reaches a peak level of noise and cheering as the crowd erupts into a celebratory roar. There are incidental sounds of rustling and many overlapping voices. The signal-to-noise ratio is challenged by the overwhelming volume of the fans, but the festive atmosphere is preserved. (5) The rhythmic chanting of "Rakuten" continues over the BGM, which sustains a bright, triumphant melodic line. The vocal density remains high. The track ends with a resonant stadium reverb as the final slogan is delivered, maintaining a high positive valence until the end.
